title: Creating an untracked part is refused for a user who has just lost Delete
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-REVOKE-CREATE) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REVOKE-CREATE-ROLE), which starts with 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit', 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • {User-D} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
  • The Admin can cut {Role-D} down during the steps to 'Part Library & Inventory → View' only, with See Financial Data and every Settings permission unticked, so {User-D} becomes a user who cannot delete inventory parts while a screen is still open.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • No part numbered {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REVOKE-CR-01) exists at {Location-A}; the steps try to create it with the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL REVOKE CREATE).
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab in {User-D}'s window.
custom_steps:
1. In {User-D}'s window click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type {Description-A} in Description and {Part-A} in Part Number.
  3. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized) and type 5.00 in Cost.
  4. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is off.
  5. Do not save yet.
  6. In the Admin window go to Settings → Roles & Permissions, edit {Role-D}: in the Part Library and Inventory group untick Create & Edit and Delete (keep View), untick See Financial Data and every Settings permission, and click Save.
  7. In {User-D}'s window click Save.
  8. Read the message shown.
  9. In the Admin window search {Part-A} on the Active tab and on the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: If the screen closed the dialog or disabled Save before you could click, write "not checked by hand" in the result comment.
  • Step 8: The save is refused with an access denied error.
  • Step 9: No {Part-A} exists on either tab: no untracked part was created.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S8-N1, S8-R15, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.6 (a new part with tracking off), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan 7 Oct 2026, §9 Security. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N1: “If a user without the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission tries to create an untracked part by any route, the request is refused with an access denied error.”
  • S8-R15: “The system accepts a status change, a tracking change and an untracked part from exactly the users it accepts an inventory part delete from today.”
